help.content:
Player token as encounter
When player token is revealed as an encounter, that token is removed from the game and another contact token is revealed.

AI vs unopposed bounty (not protected)
If bounty contact token is:
on a planet.
is a Crew of another AI.
is a Crew of Player who does not want to protect it.
Bounty becomes eliminated. Do all below:
a. Remove the contact or crew from the game.
b. Gain the Elimination Reward on the matching bounty card, then resolve its "After you gain a reward from this card" text.
c. Suffer damage on the character equal to the land attack on the bounty card, or on the ship equal to its ship attack.

AI vs Player's Crew member opposed bounty (protected by Player)
Fight against protector Player as normal.
If the AI bounty hunter wins in a bounty fight:
Crew card and token are removed from the game.
AI player resolves "After you gain a reward" from the bounty card.
If the AI bounty hunter loses in a bounty fight.
The bounty job is discarded.

AI vs Player/AI
Fight is resolved normally.
If bounty hunter wins:
Bounty job card is removed from the game.
"Player bounty reward" is gained (see below).
If bounty hunter loses:
Bounty job card is discarded.

Player Bounty Rewards
Instead of gaining rewards from a bounty card matching a player's character, do the following:
Gain credits5 000 and 1 fame.
Gain 1 reputation with 1 faction of your choice with which that player has negative reputation.
Lose 1 reputation with 1 faction of your choice with which that player has positive reputation.
When an AI gains this, you must pick a faction the AI does not already have positive reputation with, if possible.

Skill test
Count how many times the skill you are testing is listed on your character and crew.
Roll 2 dice.
You need at least 1 matching result:
Padawan: crit (skill not listed).
Jedi: crit or hit (listed once).
Master: crit, hit or focus (listed more than once).

Where to gain fame
Personal goal.
Ship goal.
Bounties.
Jobs.
Delivering illegal cargo.
Defeating level 2 and 3 patrols.
Cards from the luxury market deck.

Favors

Player can request the following favors from another player (in any space):
Advice: Gain 1 of that player’s skills for 1 skill test.
Combat Strategy: Roll 1 additional die during a combat.
Endorsement: Gain 1 of that player’s positive reputations until end of turn.
Shortcut: Gain +1 hyperdrive until end of turn.
Rulebook: optional expansion rule, and it cannot be used in a single-player game.

Cards
Do not resolve any encounter cards.
Do not use abilities on cards, except for abilities that increase the values on their ship or character (ground/space combat, HP, hull, hyperdrive).
If the smuggler AI player delivers a cargo that rotates, rotate that card and place a goal token on the new destination.

Movement
Move up to the ship’s hyperdrive value, toward the goal or bounty target.
Take the path leaving the fewest spaces from the goal. An AI never takes a longer path to avoid a patrol.
It must stop on entering a patrol’s space without positive reputation with that patrol.
It moves through the Maelstrom as if it were a navpoint.
Would end on a navpoint after a full hyperdrive move? Move one or two fewer spaces to end on a planet instead.
If one fewer and two fewer both reach a planet, move one fewer.
Two paths leaving it equidistant? Prefer 1) the path no patrol stops, then 2) ending on a planet.
If both are planets, decide randomly.
Cannot go through the Core Worlds.

Buying
Buy makert cards as normal (if enough credits and have a free card slot).
Barter ship cards (pay the difference between current and new ships).
Discard market card
up to 2 times
